title: site-watch: website change monitor with screenshot evidence
one_line: Checks web pages on a schedule, alerts on real changes and keeps before-and-after screenshot evidence.
problem: A business needs to know when a supplier price list, a council notices page or a stock page changes, but checking by hand is slow and easy to forget. When something does change they need proof of what the page said before and after.
what_it_does: Loads each page in a headless browser and waits for scripts that fetch data after load
Compares only the part of the page you choose, with regex rules to ignore timestamps and other noise
Saves before and after text, a diff and page screenshots for every change
Sends alerts by email and webhook, or writes them to files in dry-run mode
Builds an HTML evidence report in one folder that can be copied anywhere
Records timeouts, HTTP errors and missing page sections as failed checks, never as false changes, and keeps checking the other pages
run: python -m venv .venv && .venv\Scripts\activate && pip install -e ".[test]" && python -m playwright install chromium
